ambiguity_flags.note: Proposed as replacement for LAYER_2, but semantically overlaps with the canonical concept 'Snapshot Truth' (SNAPSHOT_TRUTH). Layer-2 produces snapshots; Snapshot Truth is the epistemic state derived from those snapshots — they are distinct canonical concepts. Adopting 'truth_store' for LAYER_2 risks collapsing this distinction and destabilizing snapshot boundary semantics downstream. Category A conflict.

Proposed as replacement for LAYER_3, but the term 'decision' is already load-bearing in canonical decision vocabulary (NO_TRADE, DecisionPacket, guard/state/trigger taxonomies). 'decision_layer' as a layer name creates proximity to discouraged variant 'decision engine' and risks implying the decision components (schema frozen; generator not built) are operational. Phase-gate framing for Phase B/C/D currently uses 'Layer 3' — a rename to 'decision_layer' must not promote planned components to current-state. Categories B and D conflict.
